signals.source_name: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Global Supply Chain Pressure Index
signals.reason: Public global supply-chain stress proxy that incorporates transportation-cost inputs; it is not a route-level freight, charter, or insurance price series.
Benchmark assessments are visible as market information but redistribution/API rights must be licensed.

signals.source_name: LMA/IUA Joint War Committee Listed Areas JWLA-033
signals.reason: Public war-risk area designation. Application to an individual insurance contract remains subject to negotiation and it is not a quoted premium series.
Public global premium and loss-ratio aggregates by insurance line; not route-level war-risk pricing or bindability.
Official safety notices can identify affected areas, but public official data do not publish vessel-level quoted war-risk premiums or bindability.

market_signals.identification_boundary: A price/index movement can externally corroborate market stress, but it cannot by itself identify waiting, rerouting, cancellation, trapped loaded DWT, or insurance-excluded DWT. No registry entry recalibrates scenario behavior coefficients.

environment.methodology_ko: 무료 공공자료로 완전한 선박별 CII·건조연도·연료 패널을 만들 수 없으므로, 관측 가능한 선종·선형·항로 EU 노출과 명시적인 저손실·중앙·고손실 행동범위를 결합한다. 결과는 선박별 예측이 아니라 항로 유효 DWT 범위다.
warnings_ko: 물리적 선대 DWT가 감소하는 것이 아니라 같은 기간 제공 가능한 서비스 용량이 감소한다.
EU ETS와 FuelEU는 비용·연료 집약도 규제이며 직접적인 속도 제한으로 계산하지 않는다.
속도 대응 비중과 감속률은 공공 관측값이 아닌 민감도 시드로 다음 Codex EXTRA 재평가 대상이다.
